description: This file defines a framework for initializing and managing project templates, including classes for project configuration, template processing, and file operations. It supports various project types such as React, Angular, Django, and database setups, with methods for copying templates, running scripts, and waiting for post-processing tasks.

classes.name: ProcessingStep
classes.description: Enum for processing steps, indicating pre- and post-processing stages.

classes.name: TemplateProvider
classes.description: Manages template location paths and access based on project type.

classes.name: ProjectTemplate
classes.description: Abstract base class for project templates, providing common initialization, script execution, and waiting mechanisms.

classes.name: ProjectTemplateFactory
classes.description: Factory class for registering and creating project template instances based on project type.

classes.name: ProjectInitializer
classes.description: Main orchestrator class for initializing projects with appropriate templates and managing post-processing waits.

classes.name: FileSystemHelper
classes.description: Utility class providing static methods for copying files and directories with variable replacements.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the project by validating parameters, running pre-processing, generating structure, setting up testing, and running post-processing.

methods.name: wait_for_post_process_completed
methods.description: Waits for the post-processing to complete within a specified timeout.

methods.name: _run_processing_script
methods.description: Runs a processing script either synchronously or in the background, managing status files.
